Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: Ilwww.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 58 s. 2022 June 30, 2022 DIR. LEOCADIO T. TROVELA Regional Director, DILG-Region VII Sudlon, Lahug, Cebu City Dear RD Trovela: This has reference to your ISt Indorsement dated 22 February 2022 forwarding to the NBOO requesting for legal opinion on the following: 1. Memorandum dated February 16, 2022 from Atty. Ian Kenneth B. Lucero, Director, DILG-Cebu City; and 2. Copy of Resolution No. 15-1655-2022 re Current Status of the Barangay Councilors League of the Philippines (BCLP) in relation for its accreditation, adopted by the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Cebu City. At the outset, it may be prudent to remind your good Office that as of 15 June 2021, the Department has already implemented the National QMS. Per approved Quality Procedure (QP) for Rendition of Legal Opinions, if the letter-sender opts to submit his request for legal opinion to the Regional Office, the Regional Legal Officer is required to do any of the following, as warranted under the circumstances: "If the Legal Officer finds the letter-query/request and attachments sufficient to come up with a comprehensive draft and the issues proffered were already subject of an existing opinion rendered by the Central Office, he shall proceed with the preparation of the initial draft. If the letter-query/request for legal opinion lacks attachments/or has incomplete details, draft a letter to the sender requesting for submission of complete attachments or filling-up of the lacking details. If the issues proffered in the letter-guerv/request for legal opinion involve novel issue/s. draft an Indorsement with initial position on the matter to the LLLS. Central Office for final disposition pursuant to DILG CO Memorandum No. 2010-01 If the subject of the letter-query/request for legal opinion involves issues subject of pending litigation or with other NGA or government offices/justiciable controversy, draft a letter-reply to the sender citing the appropriate reason why no LO can be issued pursuant to DILG CO Memorandum Order No. 2010-02." (Emphasis Supplied) Page I of 3 "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

It appears that you intended to forward the letter-query to the Central Office pursuant to the aforequoted paragraph 3. In this regard and pursuant to the approved QP for Rendition of Legal Opinions, you should have attached or included in your Memorandum your initial position on the issues proffered by the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Cebu City. However, for purposes of this query and in the interest of time, Resolution No. 15- 1655-2022 dated 02 February 2022 (Resolution) issued by the Sangguniang Panlunsod of Cebu City (SP) seeks for this Department's confirmation on: (a) the accreditation status of the Barangay Councilor's League of the Philippines [BCLPI; and (b) whether the BCLP is still the recognized by the Department considering that the existence of the Pederasyon ng mga Barangay Kagawad ng Pilipinas [PBKPI. Per the Resolution, the BCLP has submitted all documents and requirements for the accreditation of BCLP as evidenced by a certain Board Resolution No. 2022-0106-002 (Board Resolution) which bears the signature of this Department. The Resolution and the Indorsements, however, did not attach a copy of the said Board Resolution for this Department's guidance. The NBOO submitted its initial comments/inputs summarized as follows: 1. The BCLP may be a valid organization pursuant to Section 508 of Republic Act No. 7160, or the Local Govemment Code of 1991 (LGC) which allows the organization of a League of Local Elective Officials, including Barangay Sanggunian members; 2. The NBOO is not privy concerning the operations, activities, or recognition pertaining to BCLP and the PBKP. Further, they have no information on the mentioned Board Resolution. 3. The issuance of the said certification is not within the mandate of NBOO. First and foremost, the NBOO is correct that the BCLP may be a valid institution per Section 508 of the LGC, to wit: "CHAPTER II Leagues and Federation of Local Elective Officials Section 508. Organization. (a) Vice-govemors, vice-mayors, sanggunian members of barangays, municipalities, component cities, highly-urbanized cities and provinces, and other elective local officials of local government units, including those of the Metropolitan Manila Area and any metropolitan political subdivisions, may form their respective leagues or federation, subject to applicable provisions of this Title and pertinent provisions of this Code;xxxx" We likewise respectfully manifest that the Department has previously issued DILG Opinion No. 96, series of 2002, which confirmed the foregoing: "This refers to your request for opinion on the possibility Of organizing a Liga ng mga Kagawad ng Sangguniang Barangay (League of Sangguniang Bayan Members) Under Section 503 of the Local Government Code, it is very explicit that: xxxx Page 2 of 3 "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Further, Section 509 Of the Code provides that the leagues or federations "shall adopt a Constitution and By Laws which shall govem their internal organization and operation, •which should conform to the provisions of the Constitution and existing laws. As to the funding of the said federation or league, Section 510 of the aforementioned Code provides that It may derive its funds from contributions of individual league or federation members or from fund-raising projects or activities. The local government unit concemed may appropriate funds to support the leagues or federations organized subject to the availability of funds. We hope to have enlightened you on the matter." Lastly, we confirm that we have not received nor have any information concerning the mentioned Board Resolution, or any document related to BCLP's application for accreditation. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have finally settled your concern. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY M HORITY OF B. DINO HE SECRETARY: nde ecretary for Barangay Affairs LSIRPB/LRALLD/kuq/clp Page 3 of 3 "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54
